page: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/batch | "Batch API" | section: operation-jobs_api_routes_batch_create_batch_job/request-body

## section: operation-jobs_api_routes_batch_create_batch_job/request-body
    Batch API > Create Batch Job > Request body
    cite: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/batch#operation-jobs_api_routes_batch_create_batch_job
### Request body

`application/json` (required), schema `CreateBatchJobRequest`

- `input_files` (array of string (uuid) or null, optional) — A list of `.jsonl` files for batch inference. Each line must be a JSON object with a `body` field containing the request payload:

  ```json
  {"custom_id": "0", "body": {"max_tokens": 100, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is the best French cheese?"}]}}
  {"custom_id": "1", "body": {"max_tokens": 100, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is the best French wine?"}]}}
  ```

- `requests` (array of BatchRequest or null, optional)
  - `custom_id` (string or null, optional)
  - `body` (object, required)
- `endpoint` (enum: '/v1/chat/completions', '/v1/embeddings', '/v1/fim/completions', '/v1/moderations', '/v1/chat/moderations', '/v1/ocr', '/v1/classifications', '/v1/chat/classifications', '/v1/conversations', '/v1/audio/transcriptions', required) — The endpoint to be used for batch inference.
- `model` (string or null, optional) — The model to be used for batch inference.
- `agent_id` (string or null, optional) — In case you want to use a specific agent from the **deprecated** agents api for batch inference, you can specify the agent ID here.
- `metadata` (object or null, optional) — The metadata of your choice to be associated with the batch inference job.
- `timeout_hours` (integer, optional) — The timeout in hours for the batch inference job.

text:
Perfect! I found the information. In the batch job creation request body, there's an `endpoint` field that is an enum with the supported endpoints. The enum includes:
- `/v1/chat/completions`
- `/v1/embeddings`
- `/v1/fim/completions`
- `/v1/moderations`
- `/v1/chat/moderations`
- `/v1/ocr`
- `/v1/classifications`
- `/v1/chat/classifications`
- `/v1/conversations`
- `/v1/audio/transcriptions`

So `/v1/ocr` IS actually supported. The user's TypeScript types not accepting it might be a bug in their SDK or outdated types. The documentation clearly lists `/v1/ocr` as a valid target endpoint.

The answer is the list of these endpoints. I should state the list clearly and cite the documentation.

content.text:
The supported endpoints for a batch job are:
`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/embeddings`, `/v1/fim/completions`, `/v1/moderations`, `/v1/chat/moderations`, **`/v1/ocr`**, `/v1/classifications`, `/v1/chat/classifications`, `/v1/conversations`, `/v1/audio/transcriptions`.

Your TypeScript types are out of date; `/v1/ocr` is explicitly listed as a valid target in the `CreateBatchJobRequest.endpoint` enum.

[Batch API > Create Batch Job > Request body](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/batch#operation-jobs_api_routes_batch_create_batch_job)
